A1.evidence: Single complete file, lines 1-943: all HTML/CSS/JS inline, no external URLs, no placeholders or truncation; sprites are data (121-204), sounds are Web Audio (34-85).

A2.evidence: result.json: loads_clean false, pageerror 'FPS is not defined' at t=0. Cause: line 936 `while(acc>=1000/FPS)` inside loop(); FPS is declared nowhere in the file. The ReferenceError exits loop() before render() (937) and before requestAnimationFrame(loop) (938), so the loop runs once and dies. All screenshots are solid black.

bugs.text: ReferenceError 'FPS is not defined': the main loop divides by a constant FPS that is never declared. The first requestAnimationFrame callback throws before render() and before re-scheduling itself, so the page stays black forever. This is the console error in result.json and makes the game not playable.
Latent (unreachable): stage badges are N copies of one identical flag, not the arcade 1/5/10/20/30/50 denominations; stage 5 would show one flag, same as stage 1.
Latent: each Challenging-Stage wave spawns all 8 enemies with t=0 on the same path and no delay, so they would fly perfectly stacked as one sprite.
Latent: formation fire takes x from a random shooter but y from shooters[0], so the bullet appears at a mismatched position.
Latent: Boss Galaga first hit awards 50 points, which is not an arcade rule.
Latent: when a dual fighter is hit, the right half is always removed and exploded regardless of which half was struck.
Latent: the 'hostile' captive state is never assigned; shooting a Boss in formation simply deletes the captive, so the 'captive turns hostile' rule is absent.
Latent: formation sway is applied at all times, including after the formation is complete, instead of sway-while-filling then breathe.
Latent code defects: Goei sprite row 6 is one pixel short (11 vs 12 chars); duplicate 'hp' key in the challenge enemy literal; unused 'row' lambda in drawTitle.

summary: The file is a complete, reasonably organised single-file Galaga with state, update() and render() separated, data-defined pixel sprites with two animation frames, Catmull-Rom entry and dive paths, Goei escorts, a widening tractor beam with capture, rescue, docking and a dual fighter, challenging stages with wave bonuses, a results screen and seven synthesized Web Audio sounds. None of it is ever exercised: the main loop references an undefined constant FPS (line 936), throws on the very first animation frame and never re-schedules, so the browser shows a black canvas and the play-test recorded nothing drawn, no start and no movement. Only the canvas scaling, the localStorage high-score load and the keydown audio-init/mute handler run. Read as design the code is fairly faithful to Galaga (formation layout, point values, beam flow, escorts), but it also carries latent rule errors (badge denominations, stacked challenge waves, a 50-point boss first hit) and dead code, and it was clearly never run before delivery. Score 8/76, not playable.
